name: Bluma
long_description:
Bluma is the first AI short form content engine.

In a post-AI world, attention is the most valuable commodity. Social media is only growing faster and faster, and we're still early.

launches.title: Bluma - AI UGC Maker
launches.tagline: Clone winning organic and paid ad video/slideshows
launches.body:
Hey YC!

We're Alisa and Stephen.

Super excited to introduce Bluma - the all in one platform for AI UGC that clones winning organic and paid ad video/slideshows.

It allows you to remix content with a built in video editor and node-based canvas workflows.

We are the first to crack de-editing - cutting each scene, removing and then adding back on caption, text and on screen image popups.

No need to switch between different models and creative platforms to compile clips/assets.

**Problem**

UGC is very time consuming and requires recruitment, week long back and forths and expensive retainers/per video fees.

Oftentimes for both organic and paid, the best way to find a format is to copy adjacent competitors and remake their script/visuals exactly.

The whole process end to end is extremely long and expensive, ranging from researching, briefing, sourcing, reviewing, editing, making variations and distributing.

**Solution**

We believe that AI footage is getting and will continue to get so good that both will converge and be indistinguishable. As such, we can help bring together the whole marketing stack into one platform where all you need is a really good prompter and taste.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=98704&key=user_uploads/2724981/abcdeafe-fa89-4ddc-a571-70e9c7b880e5)

Let's say you want to recreate a winning UGC skincare ad. You can first take the URL and automatically de-edit each scene, captions, text and photo overlays. Then, you can use our asset maker to recreate all the shots exactly.

Then you can save all your workflows as templates in our node based canvas.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=98704&key=user_uploads/2724981/758866c5-48a3-47c4-b396-723ed16f203f)

We allow you to split screen to work between assets and editing seamlessly - including a creative agent and capabilities like auto captioning.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=98704&key=user_uploads/2724981/dc015a6b-b975-47ed-94bf-ae78dfe24ae2)

You can also clone slideshows and create multiple variations in one canvas.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=98704&key=user_uploads/2724981/cf3abd59-aede-4eb9-a48c-0033bd3c007c)

**Our ask**

We'd love for you to try out our product! It is still in beta and any type of feedback is greatly appreciated. There is no waitlist or paywall and you can try starting today at <https://www.getbluma.com/>.\
\
LinkedIn: [https://www.linkedin.com/company/bluma-ai](https://www.linkedin.com/company/bluma-ai/)\
Twitter: <https://x.com/getBluma>

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=98704&key=user_uploads/2724981/4e8170c8-5ad0-44ab-bf86-58710f4e77dd)

launches.title: Bluma: The AI short form content engine
launches.tagline: Your entire consumer marketing strategy run with content templates
launches.body:
Hey all - this is [Alisa](https://www.linkedin.com/in/wu-alisa/) and [Stephen](https://www.linkedin.com/in/stephen-ni/) from Bluma!

**TL;DR** Bluma automates your entire consumer marketing strategy with content templates - a library of automated video workflows that turn scripts and assets into finished videos at the click of a button.

[https://youtu.be/Pi69Jd-fnok](https://youtu.be/Pi69Jd-fnok%5C)

\
**Problem**

If you’re building in consumer, you know that it is super hard to get eyes on your product.

In a post-AI world, attention is the most valuable commodity. Social media is only growing faster and faster, and we're still early.

Short form has a high barrier of entry due to cost (UGC costs $35/video + $1 CPM, editors are $50/video) and operations as shown below:

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95662&key=user_uploads/2724981/ade8a7fd-4114-4164-ae5c-f0b389922684)

**Solution**

Instead of manually assembling a video in CapCut, Bluma works like this:

1. Create template format by chatting with AI
2. Generate videos on autopilot
3. Push traffic to product/service

Our biggest client runs 8 templates across 16 accounts, posting 2x daily. Bluma is growing 100% w/w and went from 0 to 28k MRR in 4 weeks.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95662&key=user_uploads/2724981/c5fd4e08-2eb3-4c12-80ea-bcf74db92c92)

Using templates, we can replicate proven formats and A/B test scripts for you cheaper, faster and more scalable than human creators (UGC, editors).\
\
**Our Vision**

Make video effortless and accessible to anyone through (video automation) templates.

**Team**

Alisa was the youngest engineer at 19 working on self-driving at Zoox. Stephen scaled payment infrastructure to millions at Shopify. Having generated over 6.7M views and been featured on New York Times, we have taste for scalable virality.

We met 3 years ago when we snuck into the Collision Tech Conference and spent the entire summer building in WeWork offices before both heading into the University of Waterloo. Dropped out and planned to bootstrap until we applied 21 days late and went into YC F25.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95662&key=user_uploads/2724981/cc17438d-9b2f-46a2-8827-2d2f96863dba)

**Our Ask**\
If you’re looking to start or scale your editing pipeline with templates, contact us at https://getbluma.com/book-a-call

Warm intros to your cap table investors in the video or marketing space!
